card.name: Digits in Bible verse references
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a number, mostly the chapter number in a Bible citation such as (2 Sam. 7:1-16). It also fires on digits in other numbers like heights and dates.

modes.label: Bible chapter digit
modes.description: A digit of the chapter number right after a book name in a scripture citation.

modes.label: Digits in other figures
modes.description: A digit inside a measurement or date, before the number is complete.
